user.title: Connect to OpenCode, DeepSeek or Hermes
user.description: Choose the provider and enter its API key: an OpenCode Go key from the OpenCode Console, a DeepSeek key from platform.deepseek.com, or the API_SERVER_KEY of a Hermes Agent profile.

data_description.provider: OpenCode Go serves many models through one subscription. The DeepSeek API serves DeepSeek models directly and charges a prepaid balance.
data_description.api_key: Stored in your Home Assistant configuration and sent only to the selected provider (opencode.ai or api.deepseek.com).
data_description.base_url: Base URL of the Hermes Agent API server, including the profile prefix, for example http://10.1.1.114:8642/p/tono/v1. Leave empty for OpenCode Go and DeepSeek.

model.title: Choose a model
model.description: Pick the model for the first assistant. You can add more assistants with other models later.

data_description.model: Only models available to your account with a verified API family are listed. A note after a model name describes how the provider handles your prompts.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate {name}
reauth_confirm.description: The {name} API key was rejected. Enter a valid key for the same account.

reconfigure.title: Update {name} API key
reconfigure.description: Enter a new API key for this {name} account.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the provider
error.usage_limit: Usage limit reached. Try again later.
error.base_url_required: Enter the server URL of the Hermes Agent API server.

abort.already_configured: This API key is already configured

data_description.name: A name for this agent, for example the room or purpose it serves.
data_description.model: Certified models available to your account. A note after a model name describes how the provider handles your prompts. Ignored when a custom model ID is set.
data_description.custom_model: Optional. Replaces the model above with an ID that is not in the list, for example a newly released model. Clear it to use the model selected in the list again.
data_description.api_family: Which API the model speaks. Leave on Automatic unless you use a custom model.
data_description.llm_hass_api: Off by default. Select Assist to let the model control your home. Any text the model reads, such as entity names and states, can influence those actions. Leave empty for a chat-only agent.
data_description.prompt: Optional extra instructions added to every request.
data_description.max_tokens: Upper limit for tokens the model may generate per response.
data_description.thinking: Chat Completions models only. Disabled turns off reasoning on models that think by default, such as DeepSeek, for faster replies. Leave on Model default for models that do not accept the thinking field.

abort.entry_not_loaded: The OpenCode integration is not loaded. Start it before adding agents.

data_description.custom_model: Optional. Replaces the model above with an ID that is not in the list. Clear it to use the model selected in the list again.

data_description.max_tokens: Upper limit for tokens the model may generate per task.
